name: Yed Prior
description: A star 52 parsecs away, 54 times the Sun's width, measured from its light.

radius.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 79593: radius 54.27 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 558.166 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.066) and temperature

temperature.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 79593: effective temperature 3811 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.037)

gravity.source: SIMBAD's compilation of spectroscopic measurements (mesFe_h): log g 1.45 from 2023ApJS..266...41P; the 9 published values span log g 0.74 to 1.45, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.2% of the centre brightness

distance.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 79593: distance 52.466 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.008), at which the luminosity and radius hold

text.card: A star 52 parsecs away, 54 times the Sun's width, measured from its light.
text.introduction: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 558 times the Sun's luminosity at 3,811 K, so 54.27 solar radii.
text.locator: Table 2, HIP 79593: D, Teff, L, Rad, Q

quotes.title: Delta Ophiuchi
quotes.card: Delta Ophiuchi, formally named Yed Prior, is a star in the constellation of Ophiuchus.
quotes.introduction: It forms a naked-eye optical double with Epsilon Ophiuchi.

radialVelocity.source: SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 4357027756659697664 (quality A), from 2020AJ....160..120J; Gaia DR3 measures none
